summary: Steep wooded bank beside a narrow winding road; no pull-off or track.

drivers.seclusion: Bush on one side and a quarry across the road, no homes within 90 m; secluded if a van could stop.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane passes 12 m away, edged by yellow lines and a narrow grass strip; no bare pull-off or track, and the bank is steep.
drivers.traffic: Gardens access road with quarry and visitor traffic; a van would sit in or beside the lane.
drivers.convention: No parked vehicles or campers seen on this stretch.

flags: Edge-line markings along the road; parking rules not checked
Mapped car park 19 m away not visible in imagery
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the bank; quarry open to the north-west.
